1. [ASSISTANT_SAID] LLCs (Limited Liability Companies) can act on behalf of DAOs (Decentralized Autonomous Organizations) and provide them with a separate legal identity to manage the DAO's affairs and protect the members from personal liability.
2. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The creation of an LLC does not centralize the membership of a DAO but simply provides a legal identity to the DAO.
3. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Opening a bank account for an LLC and handling taxes can be done through the LexDAO Clinic or by filling out a form online.
4. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The KALI team handles the maintenance of the Wrappr LLC writings and annual State franchise tax.
5. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Investors can purchase shares in the LLC but should respect local law and regulations.
6. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Automated investor onboarding processes are available through the Wrappr application in partnership with kycDAO.
7. [ASSISTANT_SAID] KALI provides open-source legal forms for self-certification of investors in private sales.
8. [ASSISTANT_SAID] If the sale is public, taking advantage of the Wrappr whitelisted minting and transfers is recommended.
